title: Python CapabilityTable has the same LRU-eviction replay-floor hole as Rust had (fawm)
description: Mirror of the Rust fawm defect, found while fixing it: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/capability_announce.py CapabilityTable.record() LRU-evicts via self._entries.popitem(last=False) (:105) which drops the evicted announcer's seq entirely; cached_seq (:64-70) returns None for a missing entry, and the resource's verify call (:168) passes cached_seq=None -> the seq replay gate is skipped (if-not-None semantics in verify_capability_announcement). Identical attack to the filed Rust one: flood the table to evict a gateway, replay its older still-unexpired announcement, roll the table back. Fix (mirror the landed Rust fix): monotone per-IID seq-floor ledger captured at popitem eviction; cached_seq returns max(entry seq, floor); ledger bounded (drop lowest-iid stale floors when over capacity). Also note verify_capability_announcement's cached_seq=None path must keep refusing... check its semantics: if None means 'no gate', the fix MUST pass the floor from the ledger instead. Add tests mirroring capability.rs tests eviction_preserves_replay_floor and floor_ledger_stays_bounded. Note the restart-persistence gap applies to both stacks (table not persisted at all today) - durable floors tracked separately if wanted.
close_reason: Fixed: Python CapabilityTable now keeps the anti-replay floor across LRU eviction, mirroring the landed Rust fix (fawm, commit 03c60167ab). Mechanism (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/capability_announce.py): bounded monotone _seq_floors ledger - record() raises the floor on every insert/refresh AND captures the evicted victim's seq at the popitem (capture BEFORE the drop); cached_seq returns max(entry.seq, floor), so the resource's verify gate refuses a replayed older announcement from an evicted announcer instead of silently skipping the seq check. Ledger bound: _bound_floors loop-drops lowest-IID stale floors (IIDs not in the table) while over capacity; purge_expired deliberately does NOT capture floors (expired announcements are rejected by the expiry gate before the seq check - confirmed by review). Tests (test_capability_announcements.py, TestCapabilityTableReplayFloor): eviction_preserves_replay_floor (flood with egress inserts past capacity 8 -> victim LRU-evicted -> floor 500 survives -> stale-499 re-admission keeps floor 500 -> fresh 501 accepted) and floor_ledger_stays_bounded (16 egress inserts force repeated eviction+capture; ledger <= capacity after every record). Suite: 32/32 in this file; 40/40 across both capability test files per the reviewer's own run; ruff clean (import sort fixed); mypy only the pre-existing aiocoap-stubs note. Reviewer (kimi-k3) pass 1 CONFIRMED with two sub-defect observations (refresh-path bound timing = faithful Rust-porting order; deterministic test IID ordering = specified lowest-stale-IID policy) - security/edge lenses self-run: floor monotone never lowers, 5.03 refusal policy untouched (oev1 divergence tracked separately), restart durability out of scope (table unpersisted today, status quo). Commit: cae0810a22.
